required_changes.contract: Durable atomic claim/checkpoint/journal lifecycle; no silent replay of physical updates
required_changes.issue: begin() fsyncs pending.json contents but never the containing directory. A host/filesystem crash may lose the newly created pending directory entry; the first trace creation is likewise not directory-synced. If a physical update ran before durable trace/checkpoint evidence, the prior checkpoint and absent claim/trace can look like a clean prefix and permit replay. atomic_save() also omits the directory fsync after replacement.
required_changes.required_fix: Fsync the directory after claim creation before any optimizer work, after atomic checkpoint replacement and first trace creation, and after removing a completed claim; retain conservative fail-closed ordering. Cover the directory sync ordering in a focused lifecycle test.
